# Glossary {#sec-glossary}

Annualisation
: Converting each vehicle's test history into one figure per calendar year
  (@sec-sources-linkage).

Backfill
: Filling a missing attribute with the most common value among similar
  vehicles: the same make, model, birth year and fuel (@sec-pipeline).

Birth date
: In CARS, the earliest of a vehicle's first-use, registration and
  manufacture dates.

Body type
: DfT's classification of vehicles into cars, light goods vehicles,
  motorcycles, buses and coaches, heavy goods vehicles and other vehicles
  (@sec-vehicle-types).

CAZ
: Clean Air Zone: an area in which the most polluting vehicles are charged or
  restricted (@sec-fuels-emissions).

Churn
: The change in the vehicles in an area from year to year as vehicles
  arrive, move and leave.

DfT
: Department for Transport.

DVA
: Driver & Vehicle Agency, Northern Ireland.

DVLA
: Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency, which keeps the vehicle register.

DVSA
: Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency, which runs the MOT scheme.

Euro standard
: A European limit on the air pollutants a new vehicle may emit
  (@sec-fuels-emissions).

First-use date
: The date a vehicle was first used on the road, normally its first
  registration.

Generic model
: DfT's grouping of model variants under one name, such as FORD FIESTA.

HGV
: Heavy goods vehicle: a goods vehicle over 3.5 tonnes.

LGV
: Light goods vehicle: a goods vehicle up to 3.5 tonnes; a van or pick-up.

MAUP
: Modifiable areal unit problem: results from area data depend on the size
  and shape of the areas (@sec-geography).

MOT test
: The annual roadworthiness test for vehicles three years old and over
  (@sec-mot-test).

Observed
: In CARS, a vehicle is observed in a year when it has a postcode area in that
  year.

OGL
: Open Government Licence.

Parquet
: A compressed, column-based file format for large tables.

PCA
: Postcode area: the one or two letters at the start of a postcode
  (@sec-geography).

PHEV
: Plug-in hybrid electric vehicle.

Plausible mileage
: An annual mileage the Bristol annualisation judged believable
  (`legit_mileage_YYYY = TRUE`).

SORN
: Statutory Off Road Notification: a declaration that a vehicle is kept off
  the road (@sec-lifecycle).

Test class
: The class of MOT test a vehicle takes (@sec-vehicle-types).

Type approval
: Certification that a vehicle design meets the rules for its category (M1,
  N1 and so on) (@sec-vehicle-types).

V5C
: The vehicle registration certificate, or logbook.

VES
: The DVLA's Vehicle Enquiry Service.

VRM
: Vehicle registration mark: the registration number (@sec-number-plates).

WLTP, NEDC
: The laboratory tests used to measure official fuel consumption and CO~2~;
  WLTP replaced NEDC in 2017–2018.
